CH01.name: Channel fundamentals, creation, types, options, backpressure
CH01.meaning: Core Channels overview: namespace and fit, writer/reader pieces, create/get APIs, unbounded vs bounded channels, full modes, comparison with BlockingCollection/SemaphoreSlim, and bounded backpressure. S-020 and S-062 are duplicate canvas uses of the same bounded-backpressure screenshot.

CH02.name: Reader/Writer operations, async waiting, completion, ReadAllAsync

CH03.name: Concurrency assumptions and completion edge cases
CH03.meaning: SingleReader/SingleWriter options, reader/writer count assumptions, support for multiple producers/consumers, and TryComplete/completion edge cases when readers may already be completed.

CH04.name: Manual WaitToRead/TryRead and WaitToWrite/TryWrite patterns
